Chapter 7137: Mistreated

Chapter 7137: Mistreated

It was understandable to ask for change, especially with the divine beasts’ current plan. However, the great divine beasts certainly had authority and prestige.

“We are family, one and the same.” Gluttonous said.

“If that is true, then all are equal, and if we are family, we need to protect our home.” Worldbearer shook his head.

“Elder, we are protecting it.” Gluttonous said.

“Our home is Divine Firmament, where we were born and lived, not just our inner circle.” Worldbearer said.

“The world is too vast for us to keep an eye over.” Gluttonous disagreed.

“Brat, then let’s just talk about the small family, have you been treated well?” Worldbearer asked.

“Elder, your words aim to cause a rift between us. We have always been united and when you were gone, Skykiller Palace watched over your race.” Lunar Wolf said.

Others disagreed with the united statement. After all, the divine beasts appeared to only care for themselves and were abandoning their servants and all living beings.

“Does family seal one of their own?” Worldbearer asked.

“Punishment is warranted for mistakes.” Lunar Wolf said.

“Brat, what did he do wrong?” Worldbearer pointed at Gluttonous.

Gluttonous gazed intensely at Lunar Wolf with his one eye; the latter turned pale and couldn’t respond.

“I did nothing wrong.” Gluttonous uttered coldly.

Lunar Wolf and Death Serpent didn’t respond.

“Then why were you sealed? Who sealed you?” Worldbearer asked the question that was on everyone’s mind: “No mistakes yet you were still punished?”

“Elder, we know what you are doing. If we weren’t family, we wouldn’t have sought you out and asked you to leave with us.” Death Serpent said.

“I’m not leaving.” Worldbearer said.

“We respect your wish, Elder.” Lunar Wolf said: “But you have invited outsiders into our affair.”

Meanwhile, Gluttonous’ hesitation was for all to see. The other two worried that he might switch sides.

Gluttonous took a deep breath and said: “Elder, we had disagreements but ultimately, we have lived together for epochs, we are family.”

Worldbearer sighed and said: “Then you deserve all of your suffering, no sympathy for you.”

“Elder, we respect you due to your age, but will not let everything go.” Gluttonous said.

“I do not need your respect. If you believe that you are family, then that’s fine, you deserved the imprisonment.” Worldbearer said.

“Elder, I believed His Majesty should have been treated differently in the past, but this pertains to our survival now, we must work together to survive the incoming calamity.” Gluttounous said.

“When will we be subjected to the same treatment? It’s only a matter of time.” Worldbearer asked.

“What happened to His Majesty?” Stone Immortal asked his monarch.

“I don’t know, there’s no evidence.” The monarch opened his mouth but didn’t speak.
